note: WHERE bytes may be fetched from — never WHAT to trust. Every byte from every rail is digest-verified against the pinned seal before rendering; a malicious manifest can point at evil endpoints and the pin still refuses their bytes (it can only affect availability). Corpus addresses stay EMPTY until an authorized upload puts the artifacts on a rail; a rail flips to qualified:true only with a matching row in rail-qualification.json recording observed availability.
